svg.title: Figure 1. Test set-ups for Lab 7
svg.desc: Three schematic panels. (a) Part A: a steel bar resting on two knife edges 800 millimeters apart, with three digital indicators touching its top at 200, 400 and 600 millimeters, and load hangers at 200 and 600 millimeters. (b) Part B: the same bar clamped at its left end; a roller prop sitting on a load cell supports it 700 millimeters from the clamp; indicators read the deflection at 350 and 700 millimeters; a hanger at 350 millimeters loads it. Without the prop, the hanger is moved to 700 millimeters and the bar is a cantilever. (c) Part C: a thin spring-steel strip clamped in a vise and bent far down by a weight hanging from its tip, in front of a grid board; the vertical deflection delta v and the inward movement of the tip delta h are marked.
